title: GH-AW Configuration
description: Configuration schema for GitHub Automation Workflows (GH-AW). Each repo places a ghaw-config.json in .github/ to declare its managed workflows, schedules, output routing, and notification preferences.

$schema.description: Pointer to this JSON Schema for IDE validation.

org.description: GitHub organisation that owns the repo.

workflows.description: Ordered list of GH-AW managed workflows in this repo.

notificationChannelDefs.description: Repo-level notification channel definitions. Referenced by workflow notificationChannels entries.

id.description: Workflow identifier matching the YAML filename without extension (e.g. ghaw-workflow-health).

name.description: Human-readable workflow name (should match the YAML `name:` field).

schedule.description: Schedule configuration. Required for cron-triggered workflows; omit for event-only workflows.

enabled.description: Master kill-switch. When false, the workflow exits early at runtime (checked via config read step).

trigger.description: Primary trigger type for documentation/dashboard display.

outputDestinations.description: Where the workflow writes its results.

notificationChannels.description: Channels to notify on workflow completion or failure. Use channel types from notificationChannelDefs, or 'none'.

cron.description: Cron expression matching the YAML schedule trigger. Canonical source for dashboard display.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for human-readable display. GitHub Actions cron always runs in UTC.

events.description: Events that trigger a notification on this channel.

webhookUrlSecret.description: Name of the GitHub Actions secret containing the webhook URL. Required for teams, slack, and webhook types.

recipients.description: Email addresses for the email channel type.

apiKeySecret.description: Name of the secret containing the email provider API key. Defaults to SENDGRID_API_KEY.

from.description: Sender address for the email channel.
